body: I was actually wrong.  It looks like even the `vpkg-tool-nodejs` doesnt help either.  Not sure why it wont detect it.

Hi

The problem with nodejs is that it doesn't just need to be installed into the vcpkg sandbox, but also needs to be in PATH when the webengine port is attempted to be built.

Applying [ports__qt5-webengine.txt](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/files/8355505/ports__qt5-webengine.txt) "fixes" the issue of nodejs not being found by the webengine qmake logic, and starts an attempt to build webengine. The patch itself is rather ugly though, I guess getting support for `nodejs` in `vcpkg_find_acquire_program` would be a lot better.

issue.body:
**Describe the pull request**

- #### What does your PR fix?
  Fixes #23574 and workarounds https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/fatal-error-C1001:-Internal-compiler-err/1669485

- #### Which triplets are supported/not supported? Have you updated the [CI baseline](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/scripts/ci.baseline.txt)?
  Add support for x64-windows and x86-windows , which used to be blacklisted via CI baseline. The corresponding lines in ci.baseline.txt were removed

- #### Does your PR follow the [maintainer guide](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/docs/maintainers/maintainer-guide.md)?
  Yes

- #### If you have added/updated a port: Have you run `./vcpkg x-add-version --all` and committed the result?
  Yes

**If you are still working on the PR, open it as a Draft: https://github.blog/2019-02-14-introducing-draft-pull-requests/**
